title.label: App is better than FITBOD but…

content.label:
I really like this app. The AI coaching is useful, and being able to tell it which plates my gym actually has makes the workouts feel tailored instead of generic.
It would be close to perfect with two additions. First, let me specify the bars available, including EZ curl bars and short curl bars, so the suggestions match the equipment I can actually use. Second, keep the workout focused in one area. Right now it sometimes has me leave a bench for a single exercise and then come right back. At a busy gym, holding a bench or a hi-lo is hard, so it would help a lot if the app grouped everything for the muscles I’m working in one spot before moving me to the next station.
That small change would make the sessions much easier to follow in a real gym.

Just like the title says. I can see where people would find this app useful. It has promise, but I think the developers rushed the launching. 

The “AI” is nothing really to write home about. I asked it how I could do a completed workout again and it gave me two different answers. 

The lack of Landmine exercises. 

The lack of Kettlebell exercises. 

The feature that allows you to suggest an exercise isn’t all that great because the “post” button is continually grayed out. 

The support from an actual human is atrocious. If you ask the staff a question, they’ll mark the ticket as closed without any explanation or resolution. 

All-in-all, be cautious about using this app. Don’t expect great things and take it for what it’s worth.
